verdict.rationale: Mem0's docs describe its own search as offering 'semantic and filtered search' and an advanced-retrieval reranking feature that reorders results, so developers can steer retrieval beyond one fixed similarity search. The evidence is short claims rather than detailed parameter docs, and there is no keyword or hybrid mode, so the story is only partly covered. Missing for 10: any documented keyword/hybrid (BM25-style) search mode, detailed metadata-filter syntax and operators, reranking configuration specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these retrieval controls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can steer retrieval with metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, or reranking instead of accepting a single fixed similarity search
